timeline.tweet: Lol, nah, partner came through yesterday and just left so I feel much better... A night out dancing with him was all I needed!
One day I might be able to tell the story of an ex forcing himself on me until I "gave in"...despite me constantly telling him to leave me alone and get off of me...
And to top it off, I'm attending a Women's Conference at our Braamfontein campus tomorrow! As much the request was short notice, I'm looking forward to it!!
Can't believe I stood infront of company execs and killed a presentation! Mxm...big tingz!

Friend, I wish someone had told me that years ago... But tbh, it occured to me that my relationships mirrored the weird one I had with my father, he was semi absent & that messed with my peace way before any boy could... I'm now learning to look after & protect my peace...

The toxicity of such a pairing is unbelievable!! It is so emotionally draining... When I left one, it wasn't cz of him, oh no darling, it was cz I thought I was a burden... Cz I felt I was too drained to girlfriend & be what he needed me to be... Can you believe it??
But I'm legit ready to go back to Mafikeng and then back to my reality in Pretoria.... I'm there! It's only been about 31hours...
My bestie also stopped talking to me...to all of us in fact...but I'm not even mad because of the exact same reason!

Men have this funny thing of being exactly what you want & need in the beginning then changing up and being in another whole ass relationship without your knowledge... They know your history, your depression diagnosis & still put you through the same shit that got you depressed
I'm so tired... I'm tired of giving so much of myself, whether with or without expectation, to someone who doesn't have the decency to love me the way I deserve to love...

A romantic situation ending and an 11 year friendship ending... The past two weeks have been a bit much... And I'm getting tired of people telling me how to react and not to rant and vent... But I'm fortunate to have those I talk to at strange hours of the night 😭

Enjoying being in my own space again without a pang of sadness and depression... Getting over things quicker cause I'm allowing myself to feel the things... Eating like a pig cause my appetite is back! Healing❤️

I need to figure out some kind of workout regimen and stick to it though😒 being unable to walk up 4 flights of stares without feeling like I'm hiking up a hill is telling of how unfit I am.. The other day I took the elevator from the 4th floor to the 5th, what nonsense is that?!

The other day my now ex-bestie sent me a text at midnight nogal telling me that she's cutting ties with me... Obviously I was in my feels...but I thought about the beauty of it after allowing my emotions to do what they needed to do in my being...

She told me I threw her away during a time when she needed me most... Granted, we lost contact for a few months...I thought it was one of those times when she'd go MIA and then return to tell me what happened...turns out it wasn't...
Me neither... And I have 2 funeral policies... Think I need to have a look at them both and see which is better and close the other...
Mud masking and week prepping today... Taking a little more charge of my life now...

I don't know how to feel... We lost one of our students over the weekend... Kid was shot and killed... I do not know how to feel! He was supposed to graduate this year...I was looking forward to seeing this bright kid walk down the stage... I. Do. Not. Know. How. To. Feel😢

I don't know how to feel... We lost one of our students over the weekend... Kid was shot and killed... I do not know how to feel! He was supposed to graduate this year...I was looking forward to seeing this bright kid walk down the stage... I. Do. Not. Know. How. To. Feel😢

It's quite a mind fuck to deal with. Dated someone last year who was forceful, he never saw anything wrong in what he was doing. I'd try to push him away & he was able to pin me against the wall as he was much stronger than me. Almost all our intimate encounters were like that😞

I'm working through it... You know, the guy sent me a text the other telling me that he's ready for marriage...a whole year after I ended things...like I'd care...thats all great and wonderful for him... But he still feels entitled to me! He's a delusional narcissist that one...

Always!!! I started listening to mine & I realised that a lot of my issues were stress related... Me stressing about the issues made them worse! Change your diet but do it gradually so as not to shock your system... Be kind to your body❤️

I've been buying from Game and JetMart for home things... I'm moving onto HomeChoice for more bedding things... I know gore once I move to my next apartment I'll be able to fill it without buying additional items...

😂😂😂 bona, same department even but different brands at least.. Skype everyday, private jokes during meetings, team group chats were lit with us bickering everyday... Hey, but brothas hurt me kom kyk! He resigned after we split so at least I don't have to deal le ene anymore 😂
Same... Losing a best friend is a different kind of pain...

You know! My bestie dumped me because she said I neglected her... But she wasn't answering any of our calls or texts for months... But hey, if they feel the need to leave, let them leave...their thoughts and feelings are valid and should be respected...
Me too...but now I find myself looking for jobs back in Mafikeng... It might be a bad idea for my career but it's a great idea for my wellbeing... and it's time I look after my wellbeing...
Applied for a training course & it was approved yesterday! I'm also doing my 2nd & final management programme from April to August this year! The next 6 months are going to be busy!

I was scared that the training course wasn't going to be approved cause it's expensive for a 3 days course plus exam...but I'm relieved! It's time!

So little old me put this up as a WhatsApp status... Ex felt it was an opening to talk to me (I was petty enough to unblock him so that he sees how well I'm healing). He decided to tell me he doesn't drive a Polo anymore, felt he could score some points. What a piece of shit 😒

Like his choice in cars is what broke us up when it was his cheating that did! Mxm, tsek! I'm actually perfectly happy without him...I care, I worry, I get concerned about his wellbeing and his son's but that's it...
Also, I've been tryna upgrade my phone but the last time a sales person called me, she said something is wrong with my account... How??! When money is debited from my account monthly?!
That side of Venda came to me and forced me into a relationship shem...and I'm seeing that side everywhere so it's ruined it for the other side

LRT...imagine being raped at 6😢 I was almost raped at 5 years old by my friends uncle... I managed to wiggle my way out of his grip and run home... I still have questions.... Actually having being raped at that age, and continuously still must be something else😭

I'm so petty, I redirect any convo my ex tries to have with me & bring up his gf😂. My responses to everything he says & asks for: tell your girl, ask your girl, your girl should get that for you, call your girl! You have a whole girlfriend & you wanna offload mo nna? Oa nyela!

And I passed!! Weird and early birthday gift for cause I'm always try a make the big bro proud: I am officially ITIL Foundation V4 certified!!! I passed the cert exam with 84% today (65% is the pass mark)! Moving forward!! I'm still shocked!!!
Guys, I passed ITIL v4 Foundations...this exam was released a month ago, a new version of ITIL...here I am, a certified IT person and all... What?!

Like...my crush is 31 with no kids...tall AF with a warm demeanor! His hugs....my gaaawd his hugs... I just... I cannot! I need to switch this crushing situation off cause it's causing me sleepless nights 😭
I'm marrying an email

I wish I'd seen my mom's face when they announced that "passed with an overall distinction" part before my name & when I had to go up again for my top student shandies. At the end of that day after calling everyone, she sighed so loud as if she was relieved & smiled. I felt it❤️

I got some really ugly looks😂 perhaps some girls thought kea e pona & it honestly wasn't the case, I was just so quiet & shy... Even ko kasi I'd get snaaks looks... & then I moved to Beaconsfield after my grandmother passed & somehow they changed their tune, don't know why
I've got this new best friend, my big Buddy Bear & I'm out here praying I never lose him because he's such a pure person... I don't even want to think about how life was like before him...

One friend basically "dumped" me... Another expects me to respond to her texts immediately... The rest, lol, we continue the previous day's conversation in the next week like it ain't no thing cause we get it, we're busy and exhausted...no apologies needed!

I've dated Kby guys for so long that I can see gore bo lang moed won't get me anywhere, they're part of the reason I take antidepressants & going through therapy, they took so much from me & I never felt loved...
Me and my mom! Us being apart hurts but it's the best thing for our relationship....
Got the script and the names for graduation today, went to check the venue too... Very nice!! I'm so excited for my people!!! I now need to get a warm black dress!
It's nice seeing IIE graduates on the TL with their stopes!! I can't wait for my campus's grad day to see the people walking across the stage...

I've been with people who took advantage of my nature, of who I am. I wanted so badly to stop being who I am because I felt I was being too much & needed to reduce myself... And then I decided not to...
The Rosebank College Sunnyside Grad Reader of Names... Y'all, I did the things and I'm so proud of the graduates!! I could not stop smiling!!
Two months in a place you've grown to hate is a lot hey... Especially when life nje is changing... I think I've outgrown it, it served it's purpose, a move is now definitely necessary

I'm missing my aunt tonight... She passed on this day 4 years ago... My heart is heavy😞
To another flat nje...a warmer, bigger apartment
Whipped. Gone. Completely taken! This relationship really slaps different! I love it!

But I ended up being disowned anyway😂, not because I had a baby or anything (I'm 26 & still childless cause she put the fear of God in me) but because I had friends... I know... I was raised in fear, wasn't allowed to have friends in my hood...all that...

My boyfriend has been doing the most for me over the past week & he's hell-bent on overwhelming me with spoils😭 I'm not used to this but I'm receiving it cause nobody, NOBODY, has ever gone this far & done this much... This man renders me speechless & I'm a talker 😭🥰

I think it's also the person himself... Like, this man guys...guys...GUYS... I wanna cry minutes after seeing him because seperation anxiety... I love his company, I enjoy him as a person...I'm in love with him as a whole, flawed & all🥰 being away from him midweek is tough😭

It's always funny when new colleagues decide to one day have a look at my academic record 🤣 one just asked me if I was okay during my tertiary career, why I had so many distinctions😂... is 23 out of 27 distinctions a lot?
Eh jo, special exam, it's capped at 50%... A test of mine was lost in first year, so they couldn't load my exam mark...I waited til special exams cause there was no way I was repeating that shit😂

Bruh, they should look into food too!! Look, PnP had this down pat shame... But now they changed their delivery partners & I don't like it at all...now I need to spend more money for this week's groceries til I get my money back...
